lines.en: I shift my vast bulk along.
I scrape the cave roof.
My small, useless wings lie flat.
Each step crunches rubble.
I head deeper into the cave.
I go around a cluster of crystals.
My tail sweeps the rubble.
I haul myself over a ridge of stone.
The cave grows darker.

lines.zh: 我朝有水晶光的地方走
lines.en: I move toward the crystal glow.
I stop and turn myself around.

lines.zh: 我的影子填满整条通道
lines.en: My shadow fills the passage.
I lie on a heap of crystals.
The crystals give a faint glow.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖背上退化的翅
lines.en: I twitch the stunted wings on my back.
They can never lift me again.
I nudge the wall with my snout.
The stone here tastes sweet.
I chew a piece of crystal, slowly.
My breath echoes in the cavern.
I look up at the cavern roof.
I can't quite recall the outside.
Water drips onto my back.
I can't be bothered to move.
Crystal clusters glow on the cave wall.
This silence is what I know.
You've walked into my cave.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，洞顶擦着尾巴
lines.en: I raise my head, tail brushing the roof.
That lamp in your hand is harsh.
I haven't seen a living thing in long.

lines.zh: 我低下头，鼻息喷在你脸上。
lines.en: I lower my head and breathe on your face.
Each step of mine shakes dust from the ceiling.
If you'd retreat, do it now.
This body can't turn quickly.
And I don't need to.
Stone crumbles when I hit it.

lines.zh: 你踩的那片石是我不吃的
lines.en: The stone you tread is the kind I don't eat.
I know every way in this cave.
I give back half a pace; stone grinds.
That landed on my thick scales.
I growl; the cave fills with echoes.
Blood drips onto the crystals.
I shield the crystals beneath me.
Wings shrunk, and my crawl is slow.
My hide is thick; that only reached the skin.
I raise my head. Still standing.
More dust falls in the cave.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，血滴在晶簇上。
lines.en: I shake my head; blood drips on the crystals.
Is that crystal?
I smell a little sweetness.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子，挪向那块肉。
lines.en: I drag my belly toward that meat.
Too small to chew.
Meat and bone. Put both down.
I taste it.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀退化，用不上了。
lines.en: My wings atrophied. No use now.
Is there more?
You're holding it too high.
I might bite your hand too.
You hit me like hitting a mountain.
I barely shifted.
You squeeze past my side.
I block most of the passage.
I shift as far aside as I can.
The stone groans under me.
Step back so I can turn.
My scales are thick. That didn't hurt.

lines.zh: 穴居龙的尾巴，横在洞里。
lines.en: A cave dragon's tail lies across the tunnel.
That much jostling is nothing.
I'm alone in this cave.
My kind are elsewhere.
These crystals have kept me company long.
You may stand there. It's no matter.

lines.zh: 地下住久了，话也退化了。
lines.en: Living underground, my words atrophied too.
And you needn't either.
I keep these crystals.
That needs no reason.
If you stay, don't move about.
I'd like to sleep a while.
I bite off a crystal cluster.
I swallow it whole, tasting nothing.
Not enough. More?
I push a stone along.
I don't move things that are too heavy.
I lie over the crystals to guard them.
I'll keep this one.
You dropped it? I stepped on it.
Too hard; my teeth are useless here.
I sweep it into the corner.
Footsteps have entered the cave.

lines.zh: 洞外有脚步声，我听见了。
lines.en: Footsteps outside the cave. I hear them.
A light wavers on the wall.
I square my body up.
Dust falls where I scrape the roof.
It's stopped beside the crystals.

lines.zh: 这块晶洞，是我先看见的。
lines.en: I saw this geode first.
I press forward slowly.
The floor begins to shake.
Crystal dust shakes from my scales.
I plant a foreclaw on the stone.
It's very near my crystals.
I rise slowly to my full height.
Grit falls off my back.
Gravel crunches under me.
There's no other way out.
It has backed to the wall.
My wings won't spread.
But I don't need to fly.
I raise a forelimb.
My shadow covers it entirely.
It has started to shout.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀退化，只能用爪爬。
lines.en: My wings shrank; I crawl on claws.
I crouch low, wing roots taut.
I shift toward the far end of the passage.
It has dodged to the left.
I shove the stone aside with a claw.
It's trapped in the dead end.
I lower my head at it.
One claw strike. Stone chips fly.
Rubble leaps from the impact.
It's crushed against the wall.
I bite a mouthful of crystal.

lines.zh: 我一低头，角尖挑开你的甲。
lines.en: I dip my head and my horn pries your armor.

lines.zh: 我侧身撞上你，石屑乱飞。
lines.en: I ram you side-on, stone chips flying.
I back into the dark, breathing hard.
The cave is full of dust.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你撞到岩壁上。
lines.en: I swing my head and slam you into the wall.
I settle back down, slowly.
The crystals still glow.
The cave is quiet again.
I press my whole body onto it.
Crystals shatter underfoot.

lines.zh: 我从崩塌的石堆里出来
lines.en: I come out of a collapsed heap of stone.
Debris slides off my back.
This cave is full of crystals.
One lift of my head meets the roof.
My wings stir. Useless.
I try turning half around.
I scrape white marks into the wall.
The smell here is very old.
I move to the brightest cluster.
I lower my head and take a bite.
The taste will do.

lines.zh: 我开始清理身下的位置
lines.en: I begin clearing a place under me.
I draw my limbs in under me.
It's narrower here than I thought.
I sweep the floor with my tail.
The cave drips; my wings can't lift me.
Fire makes my scales gleam.

lines.zh: 我从石台上滚下去，砸塌一片
lines.en: I roll off the ledge and crush the stone below.

lines.zh: 洞里进了水，我抬不起头
lines.en: Water fills the cave; I can't raise my head.
The blast scatters crystals everywhere.

lines.zh: 一根尖物卡进鳞片之间
lines.en: Something lodges between my scales.

lines.zh: 这股力量在压我的骨头
lines.en: This force presses on my bones.
The crystals are gone; I weaken.
Lightning runs down the walls into the cave.

lines.zh: 洞穴塌了，我一同往下坠
lines.en: The cave gives way and I fall with it.
